Spark fixture site

A small static site for exercising Spark's DOM extraction, OCR, scoring and authentication handling. See README.md for details. Every link below except "Login" is behind the fake login wall; add ?nologin=1 to any URL to bypass it during manual testing.

  • login.html — fake sign-in page
  • passage.html — plain long passage (requires scrolling)
  • passage-canvas.html — passage rendered on <canvas>, no DOM text (OCR case)
  • passage-canvas-condensed.html — canvas passage in a small/condensed font (OCR trap)
  • passage-canvas-columns.html — canvas passage in two newspaper columns (OCR reading-order trap)
  • passage-lazy.html — paragraphs load only as you scroll
  • passage-iframe.html — passage embedded via a same-origin <iframe>
  • passage-sticky.html — passage with a sticky header and footer
  • questions.html?set=1 — comprehension questions, set 1
  • questions.html?set=2 — comprehension questions, set 2
  • score.html — cumulative score display
  • answer-key.json — machine-readable passage text and answer key
